column2: Feel free to give me feedback or discuss what you have on your mind. I had lots of fun building this, so I hope you have too reading this!

Congrats on the public launch!

The repo description says "A JS/TS Engine". What are your plans on integrating/implementing TypeScript? Also I see the codebase is in Rust but there's some setup/tooling for Go. Are you planning to release it as a Go package?

Oh, the first question is answered in the post:

> Yavashark’s CLI can run React with TypeScript

Nice, curious to see how that works internally - is it type stripping? I wonder about source mapping, for example, line numbers in error messages.
